title: Turkey Thaw Panic
desc: It's the night before Thanksgiving and the turkey is still frozen solid. Rotate it through the sink, fridge and hair dryer to thaw it in time without serving it raw.

title: Turkey Carving Slicer
desc: Slice the roast turkey along the dotted lines while Grandma watches from across the table. Clean cuts earn compliments, mangled slices earn sighs.

title: Thanksgiving Plate Stacker
desc: Pile turkey, stuffing, mashed potatoes, green bean casserole and cranberry sauce onto one paper plate before it buckles. Gravy flows downhill.

title: Parade Balloon Wrangler
desc: Steer a giant cartoon balloon down a big-city parade route in gusty wind. Keep it off the lampposts and the crowd cheering.

title: Turkey Trot 5K
desc: Run the Thanksgiving morning 5K in a turkey hat. Dodge strollers, dogs and costumed runners to beat your neighbor to the finish line.

title: Run, Turkey, Run
desc: You are the turkey, and it's the week before Thanksgiving. Escape the farm, dodge the farmer and hide in plain sight until the holiday passes.

title: Food Coma Football
desc: Stay awake on the couch through the Thanksgiving football game. Tap to fight the food coma. Every touchdown buys you a few more seconds.

title: Fair Pie Slices
desc: Cut the pumpkin pie into equal slices for nine cousins. Uneven slices start a family feud, perfect slices earn whipped cream.

title: Doorbuster Dash
desc: Doors open at 5 a.m. on Black Friday. Sprint the big-box aisles, grab the half-price TV and dodge the stampede of shopping carts.

title: Cyber Monday Checkout
desc: Deals flash on screen for a second. Tap add to cart before they sell out and check out before the countdown hits zero.

title: Free Sample Sprint
desc: Hit every free-sample stand in a giant warehouse store before closing time. Grab every sample, buy nothing, and don't get caught going back twice.

title: Mall Parking Hunter
desc: It's the holiday rush and nobody is leaving. Circle the packed mall lot and steal the open spot before another minivan does.

title: Returns Line Survivor
desc: It's the day after Christmas and the returns line wraps around the store. Inch forward, juggle receipts and gift bags, and don't lose your spot.

title: 24-Day Advent Calendar
desc: A new door opens every day of December with a tiny game behind it. Built to bring players back every day until Christmas Eve.

title: Cookie Exchange Bake-Off
desc: Bake and decorate holiday cookies, then trade plates at the neighborhood cookie exchange. Keep a few hidden for Santa.

title: Ugly Sweater Contest
desc: Design the tackiest holiday sweater with reindeer, pom-poms and blinking lights, then strut it at the office party for the crowd vote.

title: Christmas Tree Lot Tycoon
desc: Run a roadside Christmas tree lot. Haggle prices, net the trees and tie them onto car roofs before the snow comes.

title: Tree on the Roof
desc: Drive home with a giant Christmas tree strapped to the car roof. Take the turns gently or it slides off into traffic.

title: Gingerbread House Builder
desc: Stack gingerbread walls and a roof with icing glue, then pile on the candy. Build it tall before it collapses.

title: Porch Pirate Defense
desc: Protect the packages on your front porch with sprinklers, a barking dog and glitter bombs. Tower defense on a snowy suburban street.

title: Out-Light the Neighbors
desc: Cover your house in holiday lights to beat the neighbor's display. Add too many and you blow the breaker for the whole block.

title: Chimney Drop
desc: Slide down ten chimneys and fill the stockings by the fireplace without waking the dog or the kids.

title: Sledding Hill Wipeout
desc: Ragdoll sled run down a snowy neighborhood hill. Dodge the mailbox, hit the jump and beat your best distance.

title: Dreidel Spin and Latke Flip
desc: Spin the dreidel to win chocolate coins, then flip latkes in the pan before they burn. Hanukkah runs Dec 4 to 12 this year.

title: New Year's Ball Drop
desc: Time your tap to the midnight countdown as the giant crystal ball drops over Times Square. Perfect timing sets off the confetti.

title: Rivalry Week Tug-of-War
desc: Two rival college campuses, one rope. Tap in rhythm with your marching band to drag the other side across the line during rivalry week.

title: Tailgate Grill Rush
desc: Burgers, hot dogs and corn on the grill in a stadium parking lot. Feed the whole tailgate before kickoff without burning anything.

title: Playoff Bracket Builder
desc: Seed twelve college teams into the playoff bracket and watch it bust. Byes, upsets and a title game in the desert.

title: Christmas Day Dunk Contest
desc: Basketball takes over Christmas Day. Throw down holiday dunks in a Santa jersey and win the crowd's score.

title: Halftime Stage Builder
desc: Roll the stage onto the field and set up the lights before the halftime clock runs out. The show starts whether you're ready or not.

title: Big Game Snack Defense
desc: Guard the wings, chips and seven-layer dip from the dog and the cousins until the final whistle.

title: Big Game on Valentine's Day
desc: The biggest football game of the year lands on Feb 14. Merge hearts and footballs to throw the ultimate watch party.

title: Field Goal Kicker
desc: Flick to kick from 20, then 40, then 60 yards. The wind shifts every kick and the crowd boos every miss.

title: Quarterback Dime
desc: Drop back and hit a receiver in stride before the linebacker closes in. Lead the throw perfectly for the touchdown.

title: Home Run Showdown
desc: Time your swing to send baseballs into the bleachers. Hit the scoreboard for a bonus, hit the parking lot for glory.

title: Tee-Ball Chaos
desc: Kids' tee-ball: hit off the tee, run the bases the right way, and ignore the outfielders picking dandelions. Dad is filming.

title: Slap Shot Showdown
desc: Five shots, five holes. Pick your corner and beat the hockey goalie before the horn.

title: Buzzer Beater
desc: 0.8 seconds left, down by two. Catch, turn and shoot the three for the win while the gym holds its breath.

title: Hot Dog Eating Contest
desc: Tap to eat as many hot dogs as you can in ten minutes at the boardwalk contest. Dunk the buns, beat the champ, claim the belt.

title: Backyard Cornhole
desc: Toss bean bags at the slanted board at a backyard cookout. Sink it for three, knock your rival's bag off for revenge.

title: Monster Truck Freestyle
desc: Crush a row of junk cars, nail the backflip and win the stadium crowd before the clock runs out.

title: Oval Track Stock Car
desc: Draft, bump and pass on a high-banked oval. Two hundred laps of left turns squeezed into sixty seconds.

title: Cheer Pyramid Stack
desc: Stack the cheer squad into a pyramid and hold it steady through the routine. One wobble and it's a pile on the mat.

title: Ballpark Mascot Race
desc: Race as a giant hot dog, ketchup bottle or mustard around the warning track between innings. Trip the leader for the win.

title: Burrito Bowl Line Tycoon
desc: Run a fast-casual burrito bowl line. Customers judge every scoop size: "They said extra rice." Speed up, upgrade the line and keep it moving.

title: Drive-Thru Rush
desc: Six cars, two headsets, one fryer. Take orders at the speaker, bag them right and beat the window timer.

title: 3 A.M. Waffle Diner
desc: It's 3 a.m. at the 24-hour waffle diner. Cook, plate and slide orders down the counter while the late-night chaos walks in.

title: Mega Gas Station Haul
desc: Fill your arms at a giant highway gas station: jerky wall, brisket sandwiches, fudge, souvenir T-shirts. The road trip leaves in 90 seconds.

title: Pumpkin Spice Barista
desc: The line is out the door and every order is a different pumpkin spice drink. Pump, steam, misspell the name, hand it off.

title: County Fair Deep-Fry
desc: Dip anything into the fair fryer: butter, cookies, a candy bar, a pickle. Rate the result and chase the blue ribbon.

title: Tipping Screen Panic
desc: The tablet spins around: 18%, 20%, 25% or custom? Pick fast while the barista watches you decide.

title: Brisket Pit Master
desc: Keep the smoker at the right temperature for twelve hours squeezed into sixty seconds. Wrap at the stall, slice it for the judges.

title: Lemonade Stand Tycoon
desc: Set the price, add ice and sell lemonade on a hot suburban street. Expand to a bigger stand before the homeowners association shows up.

title: Scout Cookie Stand
desc: Sell boxes of cookies at a folding table outside the grocery store. Pitch shoppers, make change and hit the troop goal.

title: Dollar Slice Fold
desc: Fold the giant pizza slice and speed-walk the crowded sidewalk to the subway without dripping grease on anyone.

title: Subway Rush Hour
desc: Pack commuters into the subway car before the doors close. Stand clear of the closing doors, please.

title: Yellow Cab Crosstown
desc: Weave a yellow taxi through gridlocked avenues, honk at the bike messengers and drop the fare before the meter maxes out.

title: Bodega Cat Merge
desc: Merge sleepy corner-store cats on the chip racks, deli counter and lottery machine to build the ultimate bodega.

title: Pigeon vs Hot Dog Cart
desc: You're a city pigeon. Snatch pretzel crumbs and dropped fries from the street-cart line without getting shooed.

title: Times Square Shuffle
desc: Cross Times Square at rush hour. Dodge costumed characters, flyer guys and tourists who stop dead for photos.

title: Neon Wedding Chapel
desc: Run a 24-hour drive-through wedding chapel on the Las Vegas Strip. Rings, flowers, a sparkly-suited officiant, next couple please.

title: Freeway Merge at 5 PM
desc: Merge across six lanes of rush-hour freeway traffic to make your exit. Blinkers are a suggestion.

title: Hollywood Stunt Double
desc: Do the movie stunts on a studio backlot: car flips, high falls and explosions, until the director yells cut.

title: Neon Beach City Jet Ski
desc: Race a jet ski past pastel hotels, palm trees and causeway bridges in a neon beach city at sunset. Bright 1980s colors, big waves, tight turns.

title: Route 66 Road Trip
desc: Drive the old highway past neon motels, diners and giant roadside attractions. Manage gas, snacks and the are-we-there-yet meter.

title: Campsite Bear Escape
desc: You left food in the tent at a national park. Get the cooler into the bear box before the bear finds it.

title: Tornado Chaser
desc: Drive a pickup across the open plains to get close enough to film the twister, then get out fast.

title: Geyser Photo Timing
desc: Wait for the famous geyser to erupt and snap the perfect photo. Don't step off the boardwalk.

title: Swamp Gator Golf
desc: Play mini golf on a swampy course where the water hazards have alligators in them. Hit it in the water and it's gone.

title: Ice Fishing Shack
desc: Drill a hole in the frozen lake, drop a line and reel in fish before your fingers freeze.

title: RV Parking Pro
desc: Back a huge RV into a tight campground spot while every camper in the park watches.

title: Cafeteria Tray Balance
desc: Carry pizza, chocolate milk and jiggly gelatin through the crowded lunchroom without dropping a thing.

title: School Bus Route
desc: Drive the yellow school bus and pick up every kid on time. Swing out the stop-sign arm or the cars blow right past.

title: Locker Combo Rush
desc: Three numbers, four minutes between classes. Spin the dial right, left, right and grab your books before the bell.

title: Hall Pass Stealth
desc: Sneak to the vending machine without a hall pass. Hide from the hall monitor around every corner.

title: Spirit Week Outfits
desc: Pajama Day, Decades Day, Twin Day, Color Wars. Dress for each day and win points for your class.

title: Homecoming Float Builder
desc: Build your class's homecoming float with tissue paper and chicken wire before the parade starts.

title: Dorm Room Packing Puzzle
desc: Fit the mini fridge, futon and lofted bed into a tiny dorm room on move-in day.

title: Science Fair Volcano
desc: Mix baking soda and vinegar just right for the judges at the school science fair. Too much and the gym floods.

title: Snow Day Watch
desc: It's 5 a.m. and the snow is falling. Watch the school closings scroll across the TV and hope your school makes the list.

title: Promposal Planner
desc: Plan the most over-the-top prom invitation: signs, balloons, a flash mob. Will they say yes?

title: Perfect Lawn Stripes
desc: Mow perfect stripes into the front lawn before the homeowners association letter arrives.

title: Leaf Blower War
desc: Blow the fall leaves into the neighbor's yard faster than they can blow them back.

title: Garage Sale Haggler
desc: Price your junk, haggle with early-bird shoppers and clear the driveway by noon.

title: DMV Line Simulator
desc: Now serving number 3. You are number 147. Survive the wait, fill the forms out right and smile for the worst photo ever.

title: Airport Security Bins
desc: Shoes off, laptop out, liquids in the little bag. Load the bins fast and don't hold up the line.

title: Self-Checkout Showdown
desc: Scan, bag and pay before the machine says unexpected item in the bagging area.

title: Driveway Shovel Race
desc: Clear the driveway before the snowplow comes by and buries the end of it again.

title: HOA Inspector
desc: Walk the cul-de-sac with a clipboard and spot every violation: plastic flamingos, tall grass, the wrong mailbox color.

title: Wagon Trail West
desc: Lead a covered wagon west. Pick supplies, ford rivers and keep everyone fed and healthy until you reach the coast.

title: Pony Express Relay
desc: Gallop the mail between relay stations and swap horses without stopping.

title: Gold Rush Panning
desc: Shake the pan in the creek and keep the gold flakes. Strike it rich before the claim runs dry.

title: Saloon Drink Slide
desc: Slide sarsaparillas down the long saloon bar to the right cowboy. Push too hard and the glass shatters.

title: Rodeo Bull Ride
desc: Hang on for eight seconds at the rodeo. Lean against every buck and spin while the clown stands by.

title: Moon Landing 1969
desc: Pilot the lunar module down to the surface while the fuel gauge drops. Land softly and plant the flag.

title: Streamer Challenge Marathon
desc: Invent your own streamer, then survive one hundred over-the-top challenges in a giant warehouse to win the grand-prize car.

title: Friendship Bracelet Trading
desc: Trade beaded friendship bracelets with fans on the stadium concourse before the concert starts.

title: Pop Star Tour Setlist
desc: Invent your own pop star and play their stadium tour one era at a time. Tap to the beat and swap costumes on cue.

title: Guess the Price Game Show
desc: Guess the prices of everyday groceries under bright studio lights, then spin a giant prize wheel while the audience shouts numbers.

title: Talent Show Showstopper
desc: Step onto a TV talent show stage, nail your act and bring all four judges to their feet for a standing ovation. Confetti if you do.
